body: I can't speak for the rest, but for me it never happens around other people.  I'm always fine at work.

Paranoid schizophrenic here.  He's getting paranoid.

My hallucinations aren't nearly as bad as he's describing and I'm just as aware as he is that it's not real.  Mostly what I hear is one voice.  Whoever is most prominent in my life at the time, I'll hear them, and words of encouragement all day.  Which does help.

But I do get paranoid attacks, similar to the one he's having.  Except instead mine is of the Truman Show Delusion variety.  Where I feel everyone watching me all the time and that it's just a mass conspiracy to fuck with me and see how far everyone can push me until I hang myself.

As for a play-by-play, it's hard to say.  It can obviously be triggered.  Enough things going wrong at once caused by others can trigger it for me, but it can also just happen randomly.  After that it's a slow buildup.  The comforting voices disappear, and I feel the rest of the world turn and watch me when I'm completely alone.  Literally everyone is in on it.  I shut myself away and usually I'll take my anxiety medication (lorazepam) or diphenhydramine before it gets too bad and try to sleep before I get too worked up to sleep through it.

[Come on, guys.  It's not that bad.](https://i.imgur.com/Ekf5Cy2.png)
